name: get_doc_resource
description: Fetch one Neon documentation page as markdown. Pass a slug from list_docs_resources (for example docs/guides/prisma.md).

slug.description: The docs page slug (path) to fetch, e.g. 'docs/guides/prisma.md'. Slugs use .md file endings matching the URLs in the documentation index. Use the list_docs_resources tool first to discover available slugs.
